title: The Role of Natural Language Understanding in Multimodal Video-Based Dengue Diagnosis
abstract: arXiv:2608.12677v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Detecting infection-related behavioral changes in mosquitoes from video data is challenging because mosquitoes are small, move rapidly and irregularly, and are affected by environmental factors such as background, lighting, and shadows, which can make reliable feature extraction difficult. In this study, a YOLO- and Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP)-based vision-language framework is proposed to classify mosquito flight frames of uninfected and Dengue virus serotype 2 (DENV2)-infected mosquitoes. First, YOLO is used to isolate mosquito regions from the background. Then, visual features extracted from video frames are aligned with biologically meaningful textual prompts in a shared embedding space. The multimodal model was fine-tuned using supervised bidirectional contrastive learning and evaluated through frame-level image-text similarity-based classification. translated_title: 自然语言理解在多模态视频登革热诊断中的作用
translated_abstract: 摘要：从视频数据中检测蚊子感染相关的行为变化具有挑战性，因为蚊子体型小、运动快速且不规则，并受背景、光照和阴影等环境因素影响，这使得可靠的特征提取变得困难。本研究提出了一种基于YOLO和对比语言-图像预训练（CLIP）的视觉-语言框架，用于对未感染和感染登革病毒血清型2型（DENV2）的蚊子飞行帧进行分类。首先，使用YOLO将蚊子区域从背景中分离出来。然后，从视频帧中提取的视觉特征与生物学上有意义的文本提示在共享嵌入空间中对齐。该多模态模型通过监督双向对比学习进行微调，并通过基于帧级图像-文本相似性的分类进行评估。结果表明，所提方法达到了98.54%的准确率。
tldr: 本文提出了一种结合YOLO和CLIP的多模态视觉-语言框架，通过对比学习对齐视觉特征与生物文本提示，实现了对登革热感染蚊子的高精度（98.54%）分类。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a multimodal vision-language framework combining YOLO and CLIP, which aligns visual features with biological text prompts via contrastive learning, achieving high accuracy (98.54%) in classifying dengue-infected mosquitoes.
